Author & Architecture

About FreightIQ & Rajvardhan Singh Rathore

The Engineering Behind Logistics Data — Architectural principles, author background, and technical platform overview.

Mission Statement

FreightIQ was created to solve an acute engineering challenge in transportation and global commerce: the lack of rigorous, production-grade technical literature for logistics data engineering. While general software engineering has rich resources for distributed systems and databases, logistics data architects often struggle with poorly documented EDI 214 standards, unversioned carrier webhooks, and complex physical state-machine anomalies.

Author Profile

RR

Rajvardhan Singh Rathore

Logistics Data Architect & Full-Stack Engineer

Specializing in enterprise data platforms, streaming telemetry ingestion (Kafka/Flink), carrier EDI translation, and PostgreSQL spatial architectures.

Platform Architecture & Engineering Stack

FreightIQ is engineered for maximum performance, security, and Core Web Vitals reliability:

  • Architecture: Python-compiled static site architecture producing pure semantic HTML5, zero-bloat CSS, and client-side JavaScript.
  • Hosting: AWS Lightsail, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Nginx web server with HTTP/2 and Brotli/Gzip compression.
  • Security & DNS: Cloudflare edge proxy with SSL/TLS Full mode, strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP), and automated HTTPS redirects.
  • Interactive Tools: In-browser zero-credential execution engines for SQL, JSON Schema Draft-07, and Finite State Machine visualization.
  • SEO: Complete 32-article canonical architecture with Schema.org JSON-LD (TechArticle, BreadcrumbList, WebSite, Organization).
